title: Design native PR landing for Athena's own work
summary: Write a design doc (docs/design/native-pr-landing.md) for Athena opening, tracking and merging its own PRs, per the 2026-10-12 addendum "Athena does what the operator should not have to", honoring the stealth/brownfield and untrusted-content constraints and the existing squash-chain landing rules. Design only, no implementation.

defaults_applied.how: Write the design with alternatives before any build.
Claims cite file/line and are marked read or inferred.
One design doc plus a decision entry; no code.
Requirements recovered from the BRIEF.md addenda and squash-chain-landing.md.

assumptions: Request is design-only: a written design doc, not implementation.
Design lives in docs/design/ like squash-chain-landing.md, with a decision entry in docs/decisions.md.
Review files under docs/design/reviews are produced separately, not in this job.
GitHub is the only host considered.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/native-pr-landing.md exists with status, problem, alternatives (at least: Athena opens/merges PRs via gh/API in core; keep operator-driven PRs; hybrid), recommendation, and an implementation plan, each claim marked read/inferred with file/line citations.
The design cites the 2026-10-12 addenda in BRIEF.md ('Athena does what the operator should not have to'; 'Brownfield integration' stealth requirement) and states how each is met.

It covers the PR lifecycle: branch push, PR open, title/body from the reading and verdict, CI wait, review/comments as untrusted data, merge method (incl. squash chains per docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md), and failure/rollback.
It states constraints from BRIEF.md: only this repo, never push or open PRs upstream; third-party content is untrusted; stealth mode adds no Athena files to PRs against third-party repos.
It names the mechanism enforcing each rule or marks it prose-only, and lists open questions and review needs, per 'designed' default.
docs/decisions.md gets a new entry recording the design call, and no code, tests or governance files change.

out_of_scope: Brownfield/stealth integration design beyond how PR landing must respect it
Project tracker, taste probes, artifact viewer
Changing CI workflows or governance files
departures: Slightly lower cost and wall time than reference: docs-only, no cold build risk beyond fmt/lint checks.
